quote: I'm not surprised why Ubisoft fall apart. This game is a testament of that, bad story, bad gameplay. I don't even think they play their own games.

author: saicoder
quote: This is definitely worse of Styx games. Combat system is bad and they force you to use it in boss fights, the levels are way too vertical however they did not provide corresponding tools, grapple hook only attaches to a few predefined spots for example. Secondary objectives are simple fetch quests, ok, but it’s super hard even to detect those objects. Janky ledges and climbing were a bit issue in the older titles but here are way worse.

game_title: The Last of Us Part II

author: saicoder
quote: Graphic is great, gameplay is ok, fluid movement. Quests are the worst I ever encounter in any video game for quite some time. There is a lot of quests and most are fetch quests. Characters are dull and totally forgettable. Its a Far cry game in avatar world, with outpost freeing mechanic. They even do not care, I encoded same totally outpost 3 times in different regions.

author: saicoder
quote:
The combat is actually fun, classes/vocations have sense, everything else is outdated and dumb (Quest design, enemy variety). Worst of all is quest design. 

Most of the quests are like this: NPC will send you to the other end of map to fetch some item, you need to walk because running spends stamina. On every 5m you will encounter some trash enemies like goblins. When you acquire item and do everything same to return, the NPC is not there because he is only there at night. You need to spend 30 minutes waiting for him (because there is no bench nearby).

This could be a fun game but instead it feels like a work.

author: saicoder
quote: Assassin's Creed 3" disappoints on multiple levels, earning a rating of zero for its lackluster combat, frustrating stealth mechanics, and dull storyline. The combat fails to engage, turning fights into tedious affairs, while the stealth aspects are clunky, detracting from the gameplay. The narrative is notably uninspired, failing to draw players into its world or care about its characters. Overall, this entry falls short of the franchise's standards, highlighting a significant need for improvement and innovation in future installments

author: saicoder
quote: I had fun playing original Monster Hunter World, this expansion looks like a step back. Gear is not fun to grind as in original game. Monsters have 3 times more health and fights become quickly repetitive and boring. SOS flares (aka multiplayer support) is not working well, game rarely finds someone to join you.
